featured.name: TruckersMP's Halloween Convoy
featured.description:
### Our Halloween Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**!  

  The event takes place on the **31st October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  

---

   ### **Information** 
   
   We will take to the roads of ETS2 in the dead of night during the witching hour. 
   Are you brave enough to enter? Who knows what might be lurking in the shadows!  
   
   You can find all the details via our [Blog Post](link)  
   
   ### :parking: | **Parking** 
   
   > You may park at any company available in **Paris** with a **no collision zone**. 
   
   ![Convoy Route](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/40c74b71-7a64-47ba-9bc4-a65bdfab5293.avif)
featured.rule:

* Impersonating Event Staff using the aforementioned tags is forbidden.
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.
* Participants must haul a trailer. (Except Event Staff)
* Triple trailer and HCT trailer configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Double trailer configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Cars are prohibited except for Event Staff showing a clear tag.
* Buses are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.
* Overtaking is prohibited.
* Advertising is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* Participants with consistent lag must remain at the back of the convoy.
* Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.  
All other TruckersMP rules apply.

* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
All other TruckersMP rules apply.

featured.name: Official ATS Convoy - Boat show
featured.description:
### You're **all invited** to haul a boat to Yakima! 👀  

> The yearly Yakima Sprint Boat racing now has a new edition with a regular boat show that is being held at the end of November. For this we require several boats to being hauled to various companies in Yakima from their storage location in Wenatchee.

The event takes place on the **14th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  

---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your timezone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P4sECCF_QEadR)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38596.1792995339.jpg)

---

### :truck: | **Cargo**  

We kindly request you to haul a boat  

You can use our TruckersMP Truck Delivery Dispatcher to select your cargo to Yakima.

![Truck Delivery Dispatcher](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/516fd848-53ae-41ba-9b78-7974591827c0.avif)  

If you want to know more about our Truck Delivery Dispatcher you can read this [article](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/1410)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Wenatchee** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you into Coastline Mining.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121346-official-ats-convoy-boat-show/)**!

upcoming.description:
![](https://s1.imgbb.ws/file/storage-sv1/in3cf.jpg)
## 万圣节狩猎

今年，一些可恶的Haulie逃到了德国地区，并将它们藏在没人能找到的地方。现在，我们需要您来帮助我们，以免为时已晚！

我们需要您的帮助，在 10 月 31 日 20:30 和 23:00 期间前来，并尝试找到所有的Haulie！

你会接受挑战并在逃脱之前寻找丢失的Haulie吗？加入狩猎，让我们把Haulie带回它们所属的地方。

根据一些线索，我们已经知道了Haulie所在的大致区域，它们都还在那里！有**8个**Haulie可供发现：紫色、绿色、蓝色、黄色、橙色和红色Haulie，以及**2个**滚动的Haulie。

活动将于 10 月 31 日 20:30 开始，您必须在23:00找到所有Haulie！

**无需任何DLC！**



-----



## 怎么玩？

**8个**Haulie被困在我们给出的区域中，如果您是最快找到所有Haulie的人，您将获得由**Super CC**提供的特别奖品！

所有Haulie都将由我们的活动团队员工代表，他们的前缀与他们所托运的Haulie相匹配，如：“SE|Rolling Haulie” （此前缀中文翻译："SE|滚动的Haulie“）

***请注意，在参与本次活动时，不要使用任何TPC工具，这可能会导致您的成绩作废！***

-----



## 活动是如何进行的？

在服务器开启时，选择我们的活动服务器，服务器将不会启用碰撞，这也意味着，所有道路规则将不适用。

![](https://s2.imgbb.ws/file/storage-sv2/iBO3T.jpg)
### *您必须从 **慕尼黑** 出发*

当您找到了一个Haulie时，请打开您的TAB，用F12截图 **并展示出自己的卡车**，以证明您找到了它，如果不符合要求将视为无效的提交！



-----



## 奖品！

## - 第一名的个人：75元红包
## - 第二名的个人：50元红包
## - 第三名的个人：25元红包



-----

## Notes: If you are an international player whose native language is not Chinese, then you will not be able to compete for rankings because the form we provide does not have the Chinese communication software and cannot be submitted.

-----

upcoming.name: Halloween Convoy
upcoming.description:
# 🎃👻 Van Herk Group Halloween Convoy 2026 👻🎃

As darkness falls and ghostly figures begin to roam the roads, it's time for the **Van Herk Group Halloween Convoy**!

On October 31st, 2026, we invite you to join us for an unforgettable night filled with spooky vibes, impressive truck formations, and a strong sense of community. Together, we'll transform the roads of Euro Truck Simulator 2 into a haunting parade of lights, shadows, and Halloween spirit.

This convoy is all about bringing the community together. Whether you're part of a VTC, driving with friends, or joining on your own, everyone is welcome to take part in this spooky celebration.

### ***Important Information:***
* Registration is required.
* VTCs can book dedicated slots.
* Please provide an approximate participant count when booking a slot.
* Halloween-themed truck paint jobs and decorations are highly encouraged.

Let's make this Halloween night one to remember and show what the TruckersMP community is capable of when we come together.

We look forward to welcoming you to the Van Herk Group Halloween Convoy 2026!

🎃 Stay spooky and drive safe! 👻

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 🎃 ***Event Information***

* 📅 Date: October 31st, 2026
